title: Patient option to request a lesser Schedule II quantity
rule_summary: At the patient's request, a Massachusetts pharmacist may dispense less than the prescribed Schedule II quantity and document the partial fill in the patient record.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply lesser quantity requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.

authority.name: Patient option to request a lesser Schedule II quantity

exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing lesser quantity with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
